messages:
tasha: quick review of the tiny help card we show on Routes -> Overview. noticed a few consistency/a11y gaps that keep coming up in support tickets.
ben: drop the list here and i'll prioritize.
tasha: 1) Terminology drift: the UI shows 'Reserved' in the capacity menu but the docs and examples use both 'Dedicated' and 'Reserved capacity'. users get conflicting terms in snippets. proposal: pick 'Reserved' (short & matches billing) and add a one-line alias note in docs for old phrasing.
lin: +1 for 'Reserved' if that's the billing term. i'll prepare a quick mapping to push to docs.
tasha: 2) Deep links: the small link icon currently opens the docs root. users expect it to land at the relevant subsection (e.g., routing examples). can we wire anchors and make the icon open target like: https://docs.redwood.ai/routes#routing-examples ?
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened PR #720 to add stable anchors for routing-examples, batching-hints, and kv-cache. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/720 :white_check_mark:
aria: accessibility: make the target icon keyboard-focusable, add aria-label="Open docs: routing examples", and include a visually-hidden summary at the destination heading.
tasha: 3) CTA clarity: panel has both "More info" link and a secondary "Documentation" button. both are vague. suggest: inline context link -> "See routing examples"; primary button -> "Open docs". keep copy short.
ben: agree. also on mobile collapse the two into one menu to avoid crowding.
asha: (typo) ^^ tasha: 4) Focus/keyboard: on Safari the panel doesn't consistently move focus into the panel when opened via keyboard, and ESC isn't always closing it in Firefox. we need a small focus-trap + return-focus on close. also announce panel open with aria-live="polite" ("Help panel opened: Routing").
lin: i'll add an acceptance test for Chrome/Firefox/Safari keyboard flows.
tasha: 5) Mini-glossary: support keeps seeing questions about 'KV cache', 'prefetch', and 'reserved'. propose a 3-line glossary at the panel footer, collapsed by default (disclosure pattern with aria-expanded). on <480px move glossary into overflow.
aria: disclosure must be accessible (aria-controls + aria-expanded) and focusable. include SR-only heading for screen reader context.
asha: (lol again) ^^ tasha: last: please add a tiny UI->docs term mapping file in the docs repo so we avoid future drift. lin, can you handle that with the PR?
lin: yes, will include mapping + changelog note in PR #720.
docs-bot: docs-bot: PR #720 ready for review: adds anchors, glossary markup, and replaces 'Dedicated' -> 'Reserved' in examples. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/720
ben: timeline: lin to post implementation spec by EOD; aria to run a quick checklist after review; i'll slot dev work next sprint.
tasha: thanks all 44d ping here when PR is merged.
thread_summary: Product thread reviewing the in-app help card on Routes: choose canonical term 'Reserved', add stable anchors/deeplinks for examples, improve CTA wording, make target icon keyboard accessible with aria-label and SR summary, fix focus trap/ESC behavior across browsers and announce panel open via aria-live, add collapsed 3-item glossary, and add UI->docs mapping. docs-bot links PR #720.
